messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: change-window v1.44.0 blocked — pipeline 4120 failing staging-e2e on gpu-pool; artifact restore from ci-cache returning corrupted chunks (sha mismatch). Auto-promo paused. See /ci/4120 logs.
Ravi: Breaking on ImageInference.test_consistency and Upload.test_partial_read. Looks like cache corruption during restore.
Lina: I see repeated `ERROR verify sha256` when streaming from cache. Mirror checksums disagree.
Kai: Change window ends in 30m. Options: pin last-stable (v1.43.5) and promote, or rebuild + republish (est ~25m). Thoughts?
ReleaseManager: Prefer rebuild+republish to avoid downgrading; approve one retry. If retry fails, we pin and promote.
ci-bot: Started rebuild job 4121 (artifact publish + verify across mirrors). ETA ~15m.
Ravi: Adding per-chunk checksum and abort-on-mismatch to uploader for this run. Also enabling single-threaded upload to reduce multipart races.
infra-bot: Noted elevated read errors on ci-cache nodes in us-west-1; opened ticket INFRA-443.
Lina: Rebuild finished and uploaded. Local verify OK. Kicking CI rerun (pipeline 4122).
ci-bot: Pipeline 4122 started. Staging-e2e running on gpu-pool.
Kai: While we wait, agree we should do a 1% canary once green. Keep change window safety net.
ci-bot: Pipeline 4122: staging-e2e FAILED at 9m — ImageInference.test_consistency still failing. Logs show corrupted model shard during restore: `expected sha=ab12 got=ff00`.
Ravi: This looks like cache-side corruption, not uploader. We should pin and promote last-stable to meet SLA.
ReleaseManager: Approve manual promote of v1.43.5 for this window. We'll block auto-promote until INFRA-443 resolved and cache error rate <1% for 1h. Schedule postmortem and follow-up remediation (replicate integrity checks + read-retries).
Kai: Manual promote started by ReleaseManager token. Running 1% canary then full rollout.
deploybot: Manual promote executed: tag=v1.43.5, canary=1%, reason=cache_corruption_on_staging. Auto-promo status: BLOCKED.
Lina: Documenting in release notes: "Promoted v1.43.5 due to ci-cache corruption impacting v1.44.0 artifacts. Follow-up: strengthen cache integrity checks."
Ravi: I'll triage INFRA-443 and start work on per-object checksums + periodic verification.
ReleaseManager: Closing hold for this change window. Thanks all. Postmortem owner assigned: Ravi.
